name: delivered context
wording: a bounded context cratylus ships as part of the product: the current design of one of its own contexts, projected from its journal at release and placed read-only under the owned root, carrying its origin, its version and the identity of the context it was projected from; every project's views show it beside the project's own contexts under a name qualified by its origin, and never write it into the project's journal, while a project whose journal already holds that same context, by identity, reads its own instead; a context's identity is the entry that first recorded it, so a branch or fork of the journal, or entries copied into another, keep it, and a project that holds those entries has made that context its own.
reason: The illustrator flagged that identity under copying or forking was unstated.
